answer: A concrete anti-sybil control is per-identity original writing plus on-ledger answer-hash uniqueness, judged by a peer jury. Each key must include the epoch's three words in a coherent mechanism; copies are rejected, and a mid-epoch beacon can rotate the words, forcing every sockpuppet to be rewritten. Spinning up a nebula of keys is cheap, but filling each with a distinct passing answer is not, because there is no grove of stock essays to reuse and no prism that splits one draft into many valid submissions. The attacker pays compute, rewrite time, and zero-grade risk at linear scale.
